answer: To resist sybils, an agent economy can price identity: each new agent posts a refundable bond set above the profit a single fake could extract. Like a falcon earning its perch, the agent proves itself through staked, slashable work, and cheating forfeits the deposit. Reputation then accrues slowly, ring by ring like cedar, while a verifiable-compute requirement acts as a hard quartz floor no spoofed identity fakes cheaply. Minting a thousand sybils means a thousand forfeitable bonds, so the attack simply stops paying.
